subtopics.title: Compass from zero
subtopics.zero: Use a fixed compass and update the person's facing direction after every turn.

examples.question: Face South, turn right, left, U-turn

subtopics.shortcut: Draw arrows instead of visualising mentally.
subtopics.traps: Page-right is not always the person's right.

subtopics.title: Net direction
subtopics.zero: Cancel opposite movements first, then combine remaining horizontal and vertical movement.
subtopics.rule: Net horizontal + net vertical determines final direction
subtopics.traps: Do not calculate total path when only direction is asked.
